attributes.board_name: Arizona Board of Behavioral Health Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board does not pre-approve CE. Accepted (A.A.C. R4-6-802(D)): activities sponsored/approved by national, regional or state associations in MFT, counseling, social work, addiction counseling or allied professions (psychiatry, psychiatric nursing, psychology, pastoral counseling); accredited college/university programs and courses (1 semester hour = 15 clock hours); agency/school/hospital in-service training; court/probation programs; publishing.
rules.audit_note: Certificates must be provided to the Board if audited; CE Broker tracking optional.

topics.who: Behavioral health ethics or mental health law; rule states "a minimum of three clock hours" covering ethics/law and cultural content
Cultural considerations in psychotherapy / cultural competency and diversity (same 3-hour clause)
Three-clock-hour Arizona Statutes/Regulations Tutorial each license period
Clinical supervisors qualified by training: at least 9 hours every 3 years incl. the 3-hour Clinical Supervision Tutorial (R4-6-214(B))

rules.notes: CE earned between the Board's receipt of the last renewal application and the next expiration; renewal opens 90 days before expiry. Caps: presentations 10 h, Board meeting attendance 6 h, Board/ARC service 10 h.
